title: Callaway Apex Ai200 6 Iron (Steel, Stiff, Right-Handed)
writeup: A new Callaway Apex Ai200 6 iron (26 degree loft, right-handed, True Temper Dynamic Gold Mid 100 steel shaft in stiff flex) is $79.99 on Woot Sport, with only one left and a three-per-customer limit.
